facts.fact: CLGF reports the City of Mutare's Finance Department runs LADS debt management, procurement and budgeting modules, and that its revenue collection rose from 35% to nearly 72%; the document gives no date for the change.
CLGF says LADS was initially rolled out to six local authorities, with a roll-out to all local authorities under way; the document dates neither, so its publication date is used.
CLGF, with the Harare Institute of Technology and the Ministry of Local Government, rolled out LADS to its first six local authorities.
CLGF says the LADS roll-out came with capacity building and technical and financial support to the local authorities.

systems.platform: ERP and Integrated Financial Management Information System
systems.owner: Harare Institute of Technology with CLGF and the Ministry of Local Government
systems.tiers: six local authorities first; Mutare finance and housing departments; VPN to the National Data Centre piloted in four Harare Metropolitan Province authorities
